notes.title: Team Indie - Gameplay Update
notes.content:
We listened to our players and further improved the game experience!
Dustforce controls improved. Smoother controls and it should be a lot easier to stick to the leaves in certain situations!
Treasures now displayed on map. You can now see if you are missing a treasure in a certain level, by selecting the level on the map!
Boss 2 collision bug fixed. Sometimes it happened that the boss 2 colider got misplaced.That will not happen anymore. Boss appearance now matches collider.
Level design improved. Smaller changes were made to over 30 levels at formerly very tricky parts to improve the experience.
Additional small bug fixes.
